verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents creating cards through the Core API and claims instant-issue virtual cards ready for immediate use, with a public sandbox to build in. However, card creation requires creating a user and card product first, so it is not one call. Programmatic PAN/CVV/expiry retrieval at issuance is not evidenced; only 'PCI widgets' are mentioned. Sandbox cards cannot transact, and nothing shows a self-serve path to production. Missing for 10: single-call issuance, documented immediate PAN/CVV/expiry retrieval via API, self-serve sandbox-to-live path without a sales cycle, hands-on corroboration.
